name: zzAP1_hud_proof

tests.name: the bottom strip reads AGENT MISSIONS BRAIN COMMANDS MENU, and INVENTORY is gone
standing still: the map is on screen, photographed, titled, and names a real district
moving: a place marker slides by exactly the Dog's displacement over the map scale
turning: the arrow follows the Dog and the wedge follows the camera, north staying up
in play the wallet, the map, the strip, the usage HUD and the mission strip do not touch
the mini-map sits underneath the wallet, in the same column, without touching it
the sandbox balance renders correctly: $500.00 USD, as Relay's openSandboxWallet opens it
the sandbox is never presented as real money

detail.label: DEVELOPMENT / SANDBOX FUNDS — NOT REAL MONEY

tests.name: clicking the wallet opens the fuller wallet surface
clicking BRAIN opens the Project Brain, and the strip steps aside
clicking COMMANDS opens the command preset station on the DEFAULT layout
equipping swaps rather than duplicates, and a withheld command cannot be equipped
clicking AGENT raises the terminal suite, which lists the customised preset
with the terminal suite open the wallet and map keep clear of the companion consoles and the strip is gone
restore defaults puts the founder's four back, in order
clicking MISSIONS and MENU opens each panel
every shortcut key shown on a tile opens its panel
the live photograph costs no more than the noise between two windows with it off
